name: Progress
summary: A horizontal bar showing how far a task has run — completion, upload, a quiz timer.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-progress> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `percent` drives a PERSISTENT fill node so its width animates on the shared motion tokens, and `status` recolours the fill (success/warning/error). Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Info
spec.value: percent label, right-aligned; hide with show-info=false

spec.label: A11y
spec.value: role=progressbar · aria-valuemin 0 / valuemax 100 / valuenow synced to percent

props.name: percent
props.desc: Completion 0–100; clamped and drives the fill width

props.name: show-info
props.desc: Show the trailing percent label (set 'false' to hide)

whenToUse.when: a determinate task with a known percentage (upload, steps, a timer)
an indeterminate wait with no measurable percentage
content is loading and you want to hold its layout

opinion.note: Use Progress only when you can measure completion. Keep the bar thin; let the fill colour carry success/error, not a separate label. For an indeterminate wait use Spin.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Progress cell; spec derived from the token layer (fill color-primary + status color-success/warning/error, track gray-30, radius-pill) and antd Progress conventions (8px line, trailing percent). A deliberate, documented extension.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
